chunks: For indeed, Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn Abī Naṣr narrated from Abān, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, that he said:
"Salat in Masjid al-Ghadīr is recommended, because the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم appointed Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام there, and it is a place in which Allah manifested the truth."

key_terms.أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: the Commander of the Faithful, title of Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام
key_terms.الْحَقَّ: the truth, made manifest by Allah
key_terms.مَسْجِدِ الْغَدِيرِ: the Mosque of al-Ghadīr, the location associated with Ghadīr Khumm

ai.seo_question: Why is salat in Masjid al-Ghadīr considered recommended in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states that salat in Masjid al-Ghadīr is recommended. The reason given is that it is the place where the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم established Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام, making it a site marked by the manifestation of the truth.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3142 - It is narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from Aban, from Abu Abdullah (as), that he said:

"Praying in the Mosque of Ghadir is recommended because the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) appointed the Commander of the Faithful (as) there, and it is a place where Allah (swt) manifested the truth."
